tagline_3: >>>>>>> SHOW THEM WHO THE REAL ROOT IS! <<<<<<<<
warning_body:
The game has three tone modes: `good`, `bad`, `verybad`.
All modes contain dark humour, references to crime TV series
and very specific IT sarcasm.
warning_consent: ! Activating `bad` or `verybad` requires your explicit consent to the following!
warning_consent_body:
Toxic humour: in these modes the system deliberately teases and trolls your answers.
Harsh sarcasm: blunt put-downs and sharp comparisons — no swearing, but no mercy either.
warning_limits:
If you don't enjoy a sarcastic style of communication,
we strongly recommend staying on GOOD.
commands:
- `skip` — skip the question (if allowed)
- `end` — quit the game
- `help` — show the list of commands
